CRNSL.Title: Netrunning Lab
CRNSL.UnknownText: The runner can sense a route here, but its contents are still unknown.
CRNSL.DropHint: Build mode: drop a JournalEntry, JournalEntryPage, or Item onto this floor.
CRNSL.SelectHint: Select a floor on the NET map.
CRNSL.NoArchitectureGM: Import a safe copy from cpr-netrunning or create the demo architecture.
CRNSL.NoArchitecturePlayer: The GM has not published a NET view for your Netrunner yet.
CRNSL.State.SecureRequired: Secure player controls need HTTPS or localhost.
CRNSL.Stealth.Established: Quiet Jack In succeeded: stealth established.
CRNSL.Stealth.Detected: Quiet Jack In failed: the Watchers detected the Netrunner.
CRNSL.Actions.Title: CURRENT OPTIONS
CRNSL.Actions.None: No contextual NET action is needed on this floor.
CRNSL.Actions.FreeMoveHint: Virtual movement between adjacent NET floors is free.
CRNSL.Ability.BackdoorHint: Attempt to breach the current Password or configured obstruction.
CRNSL.Ability.CloakHint: Hide traces of your NET activity. Costs one NET Action.
CRNSL.Ability.ControlHint: Take possession of the current Control Node. A successful takeover breaks stealth.
CRNSL.Ability.EyeDeeHint: Identify and unlock data on the current floor.
CRNSL.Ability.PathfinderHint: Map deeper NET floors. Branches stop independently at a Password you could not beat.
CRNSL.Ability.SlideHint: Escape Black ICE already engaged with you. Opposed by its PER.
CRNSL.Ability.VirusHint: Leave a Virus only at the bottom of a branch.
CRNSL.Ability.ZapHint: Attack a valid NET target with the Netrunner's Interface.
CRNSL.Virus.Title: Leave Virus
CRNSL.Virus.Hint: Describe the Virus effect. Its DV is the Interface roll total used to plant it.
CRNSL.Program.NoPrograms: No Programs installed in the equipped Cyberdeck.
CRNSL.Node.NoEntities: No encountered NET entities on this floor.
CRNSL.Data.Locked: Data is present, but Eye-Dee has not unlocked it for this Netrunner.
CRNSL.Data.Empty: No readable data on this floor.
CRNSL.Control.NotOwned: Take control of this Control Node before issuing meatspace commands.
CRNSL.Control.Empty: No physical-world controls are bound to this floor.
CRNSL.Build.Hint: Build mode changes only the isolated laboratory copy.
CRNSL.Settings.ReduceMotionHint: Disable non-essential glow pulses and transition motion.
CRNSL.Settings.DenseProgramsHint: Use denser Program rows in the contextual Program drawer.
CRNSL.Settings.ThemeHint: Choose a cockpit palette. This does not change game rules.
CRNSL.Security.Private: Player receives a sanitized per-user NET projection.
CRNSL.Help.DoubleMove: Double-click an adjacent floor to move for free.
CRNSL.Help.Intel: GM Intel reveals private DV badges on the map. Player views never receive them.
